pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:8.8.1.1 (order of evaluation and exponentiation exceptions, which apply 'regardless of the mode of arithmetic'), §2002:8.8.1.3.1 with §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1 ('with a precision of 32 decimal digits') and §2002:8.8.1.3.2 (each sum 'truncated to 32 significant digits'), and §2002:8.8.1.3.6 (exponentiation); this text governs only under ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD (§2002:8.8.1.3), and the compiler keeps 34 digits there at --std 2002 (PB5575, reconfirmed by probes-a-21/src/vals.cob: (B*100 + 1) - B*100 gives 1 where 2002 gives 0). The rule associates HIGH-VALUE/LOW-VALUE literals in SPECIAL-NAMES with the highest and lowest collating positions (§2002:12.2.6.3 GR10); no arithmetic expression is evaluated, so 8.8.1.x does not reach it.
